> **Prefix key:** `Ctrl + b` (press prefix, release, then press shortcut key).

## SSH Remote Workflow

```bash
# Connect and attach to session 'work' (creates session if it doesn't exist)
ssh -t user@remote "tmux new-session -A -s work"
```

## Sessions

Start new session

```bash
tmux new \ #<1>
	-s <name> \ #<2>
	-d \ #<3>
	-- "<cmd>" #<4>
```

1. Start new session
2. with name `<name>`
3. detached
4. running comand `<cmd>`

| Action                           | Command                       |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| List active sessions             | `tmux ls`                     |
| Attach to last session           | `tmux a`                      |
| Attach to named session          | `tmux a -t <name>`            |
| Attach and detach other clients  | `tmux a -d -t <name>`         |
| Kill named session               | `tmux kill-session -t <name>` |
| Kill all sessions except current | `tmux kill-session -a`        |
| Kill tmux server (all sessions)  | `tmux kill-server`            |

## Inside tmux: Session Controls

| Action | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Detach from current session | `Ctrl+b` `d` |
| Detach other clients from current session | `Ctrl+b` `D` |
| Rename current session | `Ctrl+b` `$` |
| Interactive session switcher | `Ctrl+b` `s` |
| Open tmux command prompt | `Ctrl+b` `:` |

## Panes

### Splitting

| Action | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Split vertically (left / right) | `Ctrl+b` `%` |
| Split horizontally (top / bottom) | `Ctrl+b` `"` |

### Navigating

| Action | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Move focus to pane | `Ctrl+b` `Arrow Keys` |
| Cycle through panes | `Ctrl+b` `o` |
| Toggle to last active pane | `Ctrl+b` `;` |
| Show pane numbers (press number to jump) | `Ctrl+b` `q` |

### Managing

| Action | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Toggle pane zoom (maximize / restore) | `Ctrl+b` `z` |
| Close / kill current pane | `Ctrl+b` `x` |
| Convert pane into separate window | `Ctrl+b` `!` |
| Cycle pane layouts | `Ctrl+b` `Space` |
| Swap current pane with next / previous | `Ctrl+b` `}` / `Ctrl+b` `{` |
| Resize pane | `Ctrl+b` `Ctrl+Arrow` / `Alt+Arrow` |

## Windows

| Action | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Create new window | `Ctrl+b` `c` |
| Rename current window | `Ctrl+b` `,` |
| Next / previous window | `Ctrl+b` `n` / `Ctrl+b` `p` |
| Switch to window by number | `Ctrl+b` `0`..`9` |
| Interactive window and session tree | `Ctrl+b` `w` |
| Close / kill current window | `Ctrl+b` `&` |

## Scrolling & Copy Mode

| Action | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Enter scroll / copy mode | `Ctrl+b` `[` |
| Scroll page up / page down | `PageUp` / `PageDown` |
| Start text selection | `Space` |
| Copy selection and exit mode | `Enter` |
| Paste copied buffer | `Ctrl+b` `]` |
| Exit copy mode | `q` |

## Useful Remote Extras

### Enable Mouse on the Fly

From tmux command prompt (`Ctrl+b` `:`):

```tmux
set -g mouse on
```

### Minimal `~/.tmux.conf`

```tmux
# Enable mouse mode (scrolling, selecting, resizing)
set -g mouse on

# Increase scrollback history limit
set -g history-limit 50000

# Fix terminal colors
set -g default-terminal "screen-256color"

# Intuitive split commands (open in current pane directory)
bind | split-window -h -c "#{pane_current_path}"
bind - split-window -v -c "#{pane_current_path}"

# Reload config file
bind r source-file ~/.tmux.conf \; display "Config reloaded!"
```
